strings.name: Dara Khosrowshahi
strings.summary: Khosrowshahi left Iran as a child, studied engineering in the US, then entered finance and internet management. He expanded Expedia’s online-travel business and became Uber CEO in 2017, facing cultural, regulatory and profitability pressures. He led its IPO and delivery expansion and later pursued autonomous-driving partnerships. Planned investment and deployment targets are not completed spending or services.
